parsed.rationale: Regular sinus rhythm with very deep S waves in V2-V3 and tall R waves in V4-V5 (S V3 + R V5 well over 35 mm) meet voltage criteria for LVH, and the concave ST elevation with upright T waves in V2-V4 is proportionate to the deep S waves, with no pathological Q waves, no reciprocal ST depression and no convex or tombstone ST morphology, so it does not meet STEMI criteria despite the team's impression.
